summary: Carved out of MPI-365, which recorded Boogu as out of scope for the one-master-template migration (it was already one file) but named its localised-edit work as its own card. The user re-authored boogu_edit_template.json in the G:\ComfyUi bench and exported it to comfy_workflows/raw/: 60 -> 70 nodes, adding InpaintCropImproved/InpaintStitchImproved, MpiMaskSquareBbox, an MpiString titled Input_Mask feeding an MpiLoadImageFromPath titled mask, and two MpiIfElse branches gated on has_mask. That is the same mask shape Krea2, Klein and Qwen already ship.

Todo -> Doing. Graph diffed against HEAD: comfyui-inpaint-cropandstitch is the ONLY new node pack (everything else is MpiNodes, KJNodes or comfy-core), and mask delivery is already generic end to end - maskDataUrl attaches whenever the canvas has a mask, commandExecutor sets Input_Mask unconditionally, and comfyController routes it by TITLE with MpiString in PATH_MEDIA_CLASSES. So the app-side change is one dependency line per Boogu card; the rest is the raw -> API -> runtime sync.

Code complete, awaiting the live run. Sync landed: both baked files 33 -> 43 nodes carrying Input_Mask (MpiString), InpaintCropImproved/InpaintStitchImproved, MpiMaskSquareBbox, MpiAnyChecker and the 2 MpiIfElse branches, with Input_Tier still baked 1 (high) / 2 (balanced). validate-injection-rules re-run standalone on both files: pass. comfyui-inpaint-cropandstitch declared on boogu-edit-high and boogu-edit-balanced; the key already existed in nodesDeps.js line 234 (Klein and the Head Swap app were the prior holders) so there is no new registry entry and no new download for a Klein user. progressStages stays single 1 - checked against HEAD, the graph already carried 2 SamplerCustom nodes (one per tier chain, Input_Tier selects) and the crop/stitch branch adds no sampler. Node suite 305 pass / 0 fail. UNRELEASED and docs/masking.md were already extended in earlier commits. ONLY the live verify is left, and the standalone bench currently holds port 8188 - it must be closed first or every dispatch silently runs on the bench.
